title: Conditional κ = 0.001601661522127798: six paid-frame coalescences in the added-kernel provider
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001601661522127798**, with conservative κ = **0.001601661519340063**. This improves independently replayed PR579 by **0.02506477%**.

Six A-prefix frame changes in PR579's added-kernel provider replace **12 rank-1 payments with six rank-2 payments per call**. The scalar operations, helper widths and literal owner map stay identical. Applying the change to the same 48 added-kernel calls, alongside the same 24 plain joint-prefix calls, gives the independently recounted profile:

```
H = {1:171264, 2:37440, 3:27686, 4:13824, 5:4032,
     6:4032, 8:576, 30:1, 48:1817}
```

The native complex lower endpoint is `1604230957124431220769 / 1000000000000000000000000`. The cited PR543 bit supplier remains unchanged and nonbinding. Dimension 73, live stock 7168, physical stock 7682 and rank mass 520704 are unchanged.

The source-bound constructor checks each frame change, its exact profile delta, unchanged scalar operations and helper responses, and twelve omission/overpromotion controls. Fresh admission rebuilds both native orientations, all scalar columns, wrappers, **3,015 exact phase edges and 224 endpoints**, the complete physical owner map and finite invoice, and both rational models. It rejects 11 local, 23 owner and 106 assembly mutations; timing and actual-recompression controls also pass, including 18 proof-content and 18 reference/metadata mutations. No floating-point search result is used as a certificate.

```sh
python3 -B research/kernel-frame-coalescing/verify.py --work /absolute/new/kernel-frame-cold
```

Full frozen-source cold replay passed on **macOS/Python 3.14.8 in 504.839 s** and **Linux/Python 3.12.3 in 602.684 s**. Each starts from an absent output directory and reconstructs the complete pinned PR579/PR575/PR558 ancestry before admitting the new word. Final results are byte-identical; all fourteen provider proof-content identities and every numerical/semantic invoice field agree. The source manifest covers 314 files, including 293 immutable Git-blob-pinned PR579 source files. Receipts and logs are in `research/kernel-frame-coalescing-validation`. GitHub CI status is reported separately; local replay is not a claim of green hosted CI. The unchanged baseline reuses PR572's published 18-group passing evidence, explicitly labelled as reused.

Concurrent PR582 at `747ec97129eb85b1e57bf73c934400fe08a8c6cd` independently passed all 38 stages here in 261.019 s at κ = 0.001601486955392486, using entrance promotions and a different 66/5/1 dispatch. Its verified value is below this candidate. Its new provider and owner map are not used here.

Credits: PR579 supplies the 48/24 dispatch and physical owners; `jeremykothe2` supplies PR576/568 kernels and the strict global audit; `jon314159` supplies PR575's plain joint-prefix provider, cold reconstruction and PR567 portability identities; `DominikScholz` supplies PR571/569 prefixes and width-seven frames. PR535's frame coalescer nominated these six changes. Original author notices and assistance disclosures are preserved. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for this derivative's research, implementation, verification and writing.

The all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, recursive interfaces, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic transfer and bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. This is conditional finite evidence; κ = 1 remains open.
